result.summary: The intersection features marked zebra crosswalks and pedestrian signals, providing basic infrastructure for crossing. However, the wide roadway with multiple lanes and the absence of a median refuge island increase pedestrian exposure to vehicle traffic.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross multiple lanes of traffic in a single stage without a refuge island, increasing exposure time.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction
hazards.description: Parked vehicles near the intersection corners may partially block sightlines between drivers and pedestrians.
hazards.location_in_image: Curbside parking lanes adjacent to crosswalks

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs at the corners to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility by bringing pedestrians further into the driver's field of view.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Construct a raised median island to allow pedestrians to cross the wide street in two stages.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces immediately adjacent to the crosswalk to ensure clear sightlines for all road users.

result.summary: The intersection provides essential pedestrian infrastructure including marked zebra crosswalks, curb ramps, and dedicated pedestrian signals. However, the wide multi-lane roadway creates a significant crossing distance that lacks a median refuge, increasing pedestrian exposure to traffic.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross multiple lanes of traffic in a single phase, increasing exposure time to vehicles.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the main roadway in the center of the frame

hazards.name: Lack of Median Refuge
hazards.description: There is no protected space for pedestrians to wait if they cannot clear the entire intersection in one signal cycle.
hazards.location_in_image: Center of the roadway between opposing traffic lanes

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised median island to provide a safe waiting area and allow for two-stage crossing.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval (LPI)
interventions.description: Program the traffic signal to give pedestrians a 3-7 second head start before vehicles get a green light.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment features a high-visibility zebra crosswalk and a curb ramp, providing basic accessibility in a commercial area. However, the lack of visible pedestrian signals and the proximity of a large commercial driveway create potential conflict points with motor vehicles.

hazards.name: Uncontrolled Crossing
hazards.description: No visible pedestrian signal or active traffic control for the marked crosswalk, relying solely on driver compliance with paint.

hazards.name: Driveway Conflict Point
hazards.description: The commercial driveway for the Jiffy Lube is located immediately adjacent to the crosswalk, creating unpredictable vehicle movements.
hazards.location_in_image: Left side of the image where the sidewalk meets the driveway

interventions.title: Rectangular Rapid Flashing Beacon (RRFB)
interventions.description: Install pedestrian-activated flashing lights to increase driver awareness and yielding rates at the crosswalk.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Construct bulb-outs to shorten the crossing distance and slow down vehicles turning into or out of the side street/driveway.

result.summary: The intersection features high-visibility continental crosswalks and curb ramps, but is dominated by a large gas station with wide driveways. The environment lacks visible dedicated pedestrian signals and refuge islands, increasing exposure in a car-centric commercial setting.

hazards.name: Wide Driveway Conflict Zone
hazards.description: The gas station has very wide, undefined curb cuts that create a large conflict area between pedestrians on the sidewalk and turning vehicles.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the intersection near the gas station entrance

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Signals
hazards.description: No dedicated pedestrian signal heads are visible, which can lead to confusion about when it is safe to cross and lacks protected clearance intervals.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Signal Installation
interventions.description: Install dedicated pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to provide clear right-of-way information.

interventions.title: Driveway Narrowing
interventions.description: Consolidate and narrow the gas station driveways to reduce the pedestrian conflict zone and slow down turning vehicles.
